actor.description: Deprecated legacy actor profile. GravityRAT is malware (MITRE ATT&CK S0237), not a canonical threat actor. ESET tracks the otherwise-unknown actor behind GravityRAT as SpaceCobra.
actor.analyst_notes: Retained only for legacy actor--gravityrat references. New actor attribution should use SpaceCobra where the ESET tracking scope is supported, and GravityRAT should be modeled as malware.

attribution.assessment: Deprecated entity conflation; no actor attribution is asserted for the GravityRAT software name.

diamond_model.analyst_notes: Legacy source-unbound prose was cleared in the 2026-09 evidence audit; use evidence-linked activity-level Diamond models.

capabilities.analyst_notes: Use GravityRAT as a malware capability under an actor profile such as SpaceCobra when source scope supports it.

targets.selection_logic: Deprecated legacy actor profile. 標的国・地域は、活動本文、MITRE ATT&CK、一次資料でレビューした個別補正から収録する。ETDA、MISP、旧ワークブック等の集約値はexternal research leadに隔離する。帰属国、インフラ所在国、帰属表明国は除外し、日本は確認できた場合に地域表示とは別に個別保持する。
targets.analyst_notes: [targeting-scope-audit-v1] 地域は明示記述または複数の個別国から導出する。導出地域は域内全体への攻撃を意味しない。OSINT集約値と旧ワークブック値は原典確認前にcanonicalへ昇格しない。
